title: High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction from Cannabis sativa for Long-Read Sequencing
author: Brett Pike

steps.title: Prepare plant tissue
steps.instruction: Select young shoot tips; optionally incubate whole plants in darkness for 3 days to reduce carbohydrates. Divide 1 g fresh tissue into either six 2 mL tubes each containing 2.8 mm metal beads, or one 7 mL tube with 2.8 mm metal beads.

steps.title: Homogenize frozen tissue
steps.instruction: Keep the tissue frozen and homogenize with a Precellys Evolution homogenizer at 6,200 RPM for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Add NIB and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add 1.6 mL Nuclei Isolation Buffer (NIB) to each tube and resuspend thoroughly; the buffer may freeze on contact with the frozen sample.

steps.title: Incubate and filter nuclei
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension with gentle shaking at room temperature for 15 minutes, then filter sequentially through a 60 µm filter followed by a 30 µm filter into new 2 mL tubes.

steps.title: Pellet nuclei and wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,500 g for 1 minute at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold NIB by pipetting, and repeat the incubation‑filter wash (steps above) until the supernatant is completely clear (typically 2–5 washes).

steps.title: Final HB wash and store
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold Homogenization Buffer (HB), centrifuge at 1,500 g for 1 minute at 4 °C, remove HB, and either proceed to DNA purification or store the nuclei pellet at –80 °C. Check that the pellet lacks green pigment and the supernatant is clear.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei pellet in 30 µL Proteinase K and vortex strongly for 20 seconds, ensuring each nucleus is fully surrounded by enzyme.

steps.title: Add Edward's buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Edward’s buffer, vortex briefly to mix, then incubate at 65 °C for 30 minutes to 2 hours. Use wide‑bore tips and handle gently because DNA becomes fragile.

steps.title: Remove debris and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 5 minutes, transfer 400 µL of the clear supernatant to a new tube while avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: KCl precipitation step
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 1 M KCl, mix by gentle inversion, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: High‑speed spin and transfer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 5 minutes and transfer 500 µL of the supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL RNase, mix by inversion, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL chloroform, incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes with occasional inversion (perform in a fume hood).

steps.title: Aqueous phase recovery
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL of the upper aqueous layer to a new tube without disturbing the interphase precipitate.

steps.title: NaCl and ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL saturated NaCl, mix by gentle inversion, then add 600 µL 95 % ethanol and mix by inversion; a visible DNA gel should form.

steps.title: DNA collection with loop
steps.instruction: Using a plastic inoculation loop or a P200 tip, hook out the DNA gel and transfer it into a tube containing 1 mL 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes, then transfer the DNA gel into another tube with 1 mL fresh 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Centrifuge and dry DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,000 g for 1 minute, discard the ethanol, and air‑dry the DNA gel at room temperature for 30 minutes until it appears clear.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in EB buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried DNA in 100 µL EB buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.0, no EDTA).

steps.title: Overnight relaxation
steps.instruction: Incubate the DNA solution at room temperature overnight to allow the high‑molecular‑weight DNA to relax before quality control; the DNA should be viscous and fully dissolved.
